description: Building FMS Aqua, GreenFeed’s fish farm management system, as an outsourced project, including its warehouse integration, with Claude Code at the center of how I design, build, and review.

Built the Sales module of FMS, the company’s pig farm management system, in a 14-person team: everything from a weighed pig to an order, a price, and an e-invoice. Also built the background workers that sync orders from Odoo to Solomon, 1,000–2,000 transactions a day.
Building e-commerce sites and Telegram bots for individual clients, end to end: backend, frontend, and deployment on a VPS with Docker. The largest so far is DBL Store.

Built APIs for the internal lending portal and service gateway across the whole loan lifecycle (applications, appraisal, approval, and disbursement), integrating banking systems, MoMo, and partner APIs for money transfers.

Built and maintained Transaction Counter, the system branches use for telecom contract transactions, across backend and frontend, then helped rebuild it on .NET 6 microservices in a 5-person team. Along the way I wrote shared libraries for logging, caching, and data access, and hardened the APIs against SQL injection and request flooding.

Maintained the company’s ERP and outsourced projects, and built a scheduled service that collected bank and lottery data every day, with Redis caching, centralized logging on Elasticsearch and Kibana, and Telegram and email alerts for results and errors.
